svg.title: To Pneuma to Hagion: the Holy Spirit; literally, the Spirit, the holy one
svg.desc: To Pneuma to Hagion, τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον: the Holy Spirit; literally, the Spirit, the holy one. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit. (Acts 2:4 (ESV)). In the scene: all together in one place, sitting (Acts 2:1-2); a sound from heaven like a mighty rushing wind, filling the house (2:2); divided tongues as of fire, resting on each one (2:3). Not stated, drawn for the scene: the house drawn open to show them.
